title: Department Rule on the Repeat Lookback for Late Report Penalties
content:
**1. The repeat lookback.** When a late report penalty is worked out on an account in the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the late report penalties already booked on the account are counted over the repeat lookback. The repeat lookback is counted in whole months back from the day the penalty is worked out, by the entry dates of the late report penalties.

**2. Its length.** The length of the repeat lookback follows the account's whole months of liability since registration, counted from the registration date on the account to the day the penalty is worked out:

| Whole months of liability since registration | Repeat lookback |
|---|---|
| At least 120 | 12 months |
| Fewer than 36 | The account's whole liability: one month more than its whole months of liability |
| Any other figure (36 to 119) | 24 months |

## Both sides of each boundary

| Whole months of liability | Repeat lookback |
|---|---|
| 120 | 12 months |
| 119 | 24 months |
| 36 | 24 months |
| 35 | 36 months (35 and one more) |
| 8 | 9 months (8 and one more) |

## Hypothetical accounts, penalty worked out on 5 August 2026

- **Registered 10 March 2021.** From 10 March 2021 to 5 August 2026 there are 64 whole months; the repeat lookback is 24 months.
- **Registered 20 November 2024.** There are 20 whole months to 5 August 2026; the repeat lookback is 21 months, which reaches back over the whole liability.
- **Registered 1 June 2016.** There are 122 whole months; the repeat lookback is 12 months.
